correctness.rationale: The result reconstructs periodic susceptibility as a positive renewal integral, proving strict convexity at fixed hazard mass, and uses the adjoint product first variation to certify the global optimizer. Two one-sided exact derivatives yield a necessary and sufficient sharp single-pulse cutoff for all admissible parameters. On the stated extra parameter condition, exact state/adjoint matching, strict monotonicity and a globally verified switching inequality prove the intermediate pulse-plus-continuous branch through M_1. Normalizations, equality cases and no-classification limits are explicit. The standalone exact-rational/numerical checker passes, while finite sampling is not used to establish the infinite-parameter theorem.

value.rationale: The fixed-hazard-budget all-parameter single-pulse limit and exact next mixed-pulse branch answer explicit mathematical questions left numerical in a new seasonal epidemic vaccination source. They distinguish globally optimal pure pulse campaigns from necessary mixed vaccination, give a parameterized supply-versus-pulse strength rule, and offer a self-contained exact analytic benchmark for numerical seasonal allocation algorithms. They are not textbook renaming or a minor precision increment, while clinical efficacy is explicitly out of scope.
